Near Home.summary: Join us at The Kenwood Dairy for an exhibition of this year’s top Hampstead Heath photo competition entries. The exhibition will include spectacular photographs of Hampstead Heath, including this year’s winning entry, a beautiful image by Joe Hayman, and the winning under 18s entry, a great shot by Milo Dawes, aged 13. No need to book, stop by between 10am-3pm from the 26th-28th of November. Teas
